# Performance

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask bench --report` from a results file. Do not edit: run the benchmark and generate it again (spec/harness.md "bench", "The report"). -->

What `cargo xtask bench` measured: the time, peak memory and output size of turning each
benchmark input (`bench/manifest`) into an object file, with `llc -O0` and with hod.

**One machine.** These are the numbers of a single development host, which runs other work
while it is measured. They say what to expect there and how hod compares with `llc` on the
same input in the same run; they are not portable, and the gate (`cargo xtask bench --check`)
compares against a baseline recorded on the machine it runs on.

## hod

`hod` is hod in strict mode: what it builds by itself. A module it does not support yet is
a decline, reported with its reason and what declining cost, never as a time for building
nothing. `hod+fallback` is hod with `llc` as its fallback, what a hybrid build runs: its
ratio to `llc` is the price of going through hod for a module hod hands on. Ratios are to
`llc` on the same input in the same run.
